message.content:
You are implementing Task 6 of a Kustomize Kubernetes deployment for the `churn-renewal-forecast` app. All base resources (Tasks 1-5) are already committed — your job is to create the cluster overlay only.

## Context

This is a Next.js + pg-boss worker app deployed to `eks-shared-infra-use1-2` cluster. The base Kustomize layer is complete at `deploy/kubernetes/base/`. You are creating the overlay at `deploy/kubernetes/deploy/eks-shared-infra-use1-2/`.

## Files to Create

All in: `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/churn-renewal-forecast/deploy/kubernetes/deploy/eks-shared-infra-use1-2/`

### 1. `.app.yaml` — Flux metadata

```yaml
app: churn-renewal-forecast
namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
cluster: eks-shared-infra-use1-2
```

### 2. `ingress-patch.yaml` — Strategic merge patch adding private ingress annotations

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: churn-renewal-forecast
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-internal: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
```

### 3. `serviceaccount.yaml` — SA patch stub with IRSA annotation commented out

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: churn-renewal-forecast
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
  # annotations:
  #   eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/churn-renewal-forecast
```

### 4. `kustomization.yaml` — Overlay root

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

patches:
  - path: ingress-patch.yaml
  - path: serviceaccount.yaml
```

## Steps

1. Create the directory: `mkdir -p deploy/kubernetes/deploy/eks-shared-infra-use1-2`
2. Write all four files exactly as shown above
3. Validate: `kustomize build deploy/kubernetes/deploy/eks-shared-infra-use1-2`
   - Expected: All base resources + the Ingress should now have both `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-internal: "true"` and `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal` annotations
   - If `kustomize` is not installed, try `kubectl kustomize deploy/kubernetes/deploy/eks-shared-infra-use1-2`
4. Commit:
   ```bash
   git add deploy/kubernetes/deploy/
   git commit -m "feat: add eks-shared-infra-use1-2 overlay (private ingress, sa stub)"
   ```

## Important

- Working directory: `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/churn-renewal-forecast`
- Do NOT modify any existing files — only create these four new files
- Do NOT use `cat`, `head`, or `tail` — use the Read tool to read files
- The `.app.yaml` filename starts with a dot — make sure it's created correctly

## Status

When done, report:
- **Status:** DONE
- **Commit SHA:** (the short SHA)
- Validation output summary (confirm annotations appeared on the Ingress)

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: v1
data:
  APP_URL: https://churn-forecast.infrastructure.immuta.io
  NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_AFTER_SIGN_IN_URL: /
  NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_AFTER_SIGN_UP_URL: /
  NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ""
  NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_SIGN_IN_URL: /sign-in
  NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_SIGN_UP_URL: /sign-up
  NEXT_PUBLIC_PRODUCTBOARD_WORKSPACE: ""
  PG_POOL_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS: "2000"
  PG_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS: "30000"
  PG_POOL_MAX: "10"
  SLACK_TEST_CHANNEL: ""
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: web
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 80
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 3000
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: web
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  type: ClusterIP
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: web
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-web
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: web
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: web
        app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
    spec:
      containers:
      - command:
        - bun
        - run
        - start
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: churn-renewal-forecast-config
        - secretRef:
            name: churn-renewal-forecast
        image: registry.ic-ops.net/churn-renewal-forecast:latest
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/health/live
            port: 3000
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 20
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        name: web
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
          name: http
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/health/ready
            port: 3000
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
      serviceAccountName: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: worker
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-worker
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: worker
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: worker
        app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
    spec:
      containers:
      - command:
        - bunx
        - tsx
        - src/worker/index.ts
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: churn-renewal-forecast-config
        - secretRef:
            name: churn-renewal-forecast
        image: registry.ic-ops.net/churn-renewal-forecast:latest
        name: worker
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
      serviceAccountName: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: migrate
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-migrate
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  backoffLimit: 3
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/component: migrate
        app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
    spec:
      containers:
      - command:
        - bunx
        - prisma
        - migrate
        - deploy
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: churn-renewal-forecast-config
        - secretRef:
            name: churn-renewal-forecast
        image: registry.ic-ops.net/churn-renewal-forecast:latest
        name: migrate
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      serviceAccountName: churn-renewal-forecast
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 300
---
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-allow-dns
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  egress:
  - toEndpoints:
    - matchLabels:
        k8s-app: kube-dns
        k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace: kube-system
    toPorts:
    - ports:
      - port: "53"
        protocol: UDP
      rules:
        dns:
        - matchPattern: '*'
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-allow-external
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  egress:
  - toFQDNs:
    - matchName: clerk.com
    - matchPattern: '*.clerk.com'
    - matchName: api.frontapp.com
    - matchName: api.productboard.com
    - matchName: slack.com
    - matchPattern: '*.slack.com'
    toPorts:
    - ports:
      - port: "443"
        protocol: TCP
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-allow-rds
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  egress:
  - toCIDR:
    - 0.0.0.0/0
    toPorts:
    - ports:
      - port: "5432"
        protocol: TCP
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  data:
  - remoteRef:
      key: /internal/churn-renewal-forecast
      property: DATABASE_URL
    secretKey: DATABASE_URL
  - remoteRef:
      key: /internal/churn-renewal-forecast
      property: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
    secretKey: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
  - remoteRef:
      key: /internal/churn-renewal-forecast
      property: FRONT_API_TOKEN
    secretKey: FRONT_API_TOKEN
  - remoteRef:
      key: /internal/churn-renewal-forecast
      property: FRONT_API_TOKEN_2
    secretKey: FRONT_API_TOKEN_2
  - remoteRef:
      key: /internal/churn-renewal-forecast
      property: PRODUCTBOARD_API_KEY
    secretKey: PRODUCTBOARD_API_KEY
  - remoteRef:
      key: /internal/churn-renewal-forecast
      property: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
    secretKey: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
    name: vault
  target:
    creationPolicy: Owner
    name: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-internal: "true"
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: web
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
  - host: churn-forecast.infrastructure.immuta.io
    http:
      paths:
      - backend:
          service:
            name: churn-renewal-forecast
            port:
              name: http
        path: /
        pathType: Prefix
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - churn-forecast.infrastructure.immuta.io
    secretName: churn-renewal-forecast-tls
